daily.retelling.0: At first the earth was without form, and darkness lay over the deep. God brought light, separated it from the darkness, and named them Day and Night.
daily.retelling.1: Moses stretched his hand over the sea. A strong east wind blew through the night, and the Israelites crossed on dry ground with water on either side.
daily.retelling.2: Ruth asked to gather what the harvesters left behind. Boaz told her she could stay in his field and drink from the jars his workers had filled. She brought the grain home to Naomi.
daily.retelling.3: Saul offered David his armor, but David took it off. He chose five smooth stones from the brook and went out with his sling to meet Goliath.
daily.retelling.4: Daniel went home and prayed at his open windows as he had before. The king had him put in the lions’ den. At dawn the king hurried back and found Daniel alive.
daily.retelling.5: Jesus was asleep in the boat when the storm came. The disciples woke him, and he spoke to the wind and the sea. The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
daily.retelling.6: Mary found the stone moved from the tomb and ran to tell the disciples. Later she stood outside weeping. She recognized Jesus when he called her by name.
daily.draft.0: God brings light into the darkness.
daily.draft.1: The Israelites reach the sea with Pharaoh’s army behind them.
daily.draft.2: Ruth goes to gather grain and meets Boaz.
daily.draft.3: David steps forward to face Goliath.
daily.draft.4: Daniel keeps praying when the king’s decree forbids it.
daily.draft.5: The disciples wake Jesus as the wind batters their boat.
daily.draft.6: Mary Magdalene goes to the tomb while it is still dark.
